payload.goal: The board gets a top-middle toolbar; a phone-connect icon renders a locally-encoded QR in the details pane so the owner scans to pair the phone lane - making the from-away bless testable for the first time.
payload.pulled_in:
INHERITED from the abandoned i8b-phone-connect (its blessed M1 + M2 design carry over by pointer + delta):
- A top-middle board toolbar of small icons: a greyed book placeholder (until i6) and an active phone-connect icon.
- The connect action: clicking phone-connect generates the ntfy topic pair, writes ~/.se/<project>/phone.json (enabled), and renders a QR in the details pane, ENCODED LOCALLY - the topic is the credential, never sent to an external image/QR service.
- Dependency is free (se.adr-install-over-zerodep): the QR encoder is vendored or hand-rolled (~200 lines fine); one-click install is the law, zero-dep is not; a new dependency passes se.meth-dependency-ship-review at ship.
- The config-write amendment (owner-confirmed): the engine writing phone.json amends adr-phone-secret-machine-local - acceptable, topic-possession is the authenticity model.
FROM i5b (proven live this session): i8c runs in its OWN worktree - the first real iteration on the default worktree lane.
payload.left_out:
